claim: If any Amazon EMR nodes are unhealthy for more than 45 minutes, Amazon EMR will gracefully replace the nodes.
question: EMR unhealthy node replacement: after how long is an unhealthy node replaced?

qualifiers.scope: unhealthy core nodes of an EMR cluster with unhealthy node replacement turned on
qualifiers.condition: The page says the time before a node is gracefully decommissioned or terminated can be subject to change.

note: d021. Graceful replacement of unhealthy core nodes announced 2024-04-01 (change feed; What's New pages of 2024 are blocked by robots.txt).
